description: Election Commission - Amendment the Registration of Electors Act, No. 22 of 2021, Extraordinary Gazette No. 2404/18 Dated 01.10.2024 Supplementary Electoral Register 2024 (2) (Order under Article 98 (8) of the Constitution)
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to electoral processes, specifically the certification of electoral registers and the allocation of parliamentary seats to electoral districts. It is issued by the Election Commission under constitutional authority (Article 98(8)) and involves the core electoral function of determining representation. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for matters including electoral boundary changes and electoral commission decisions.
